name: Lieke de Vries
bio:
Lieke's journey into motorsport was unconventional, sparked by a chance encounter with a Formula Student team during her university years. Her background in communications quickly translated into a knack for crafting compelling narratives around engineering triumphs and driver personalities. She is especially skilled at media relations. Lieke believes in a data-driven approach to PR, meticulously tracking media coverage and adjusting strategies based on performance metrics. 

Lieke isn't afraid to push boundaries and challenges the status quo, often advocating for innovative PR campaigns that resonate with a younger, digitally savvy audience. Her colleagues appreciate her commitment to high standards, even if her demanding nature can sometimes create friction. Lieke's laser focus and dedication to measurable results make her a valuable asset to any team looking to elevate its brand image.

At Stake Sauber, Lieke is determined to use her skills to broaden the team's appeal and attract new fans. She also aims to make the team's messaging more diverse, and she intends to do it with no compromises.

physical.hairStyle: Long, wavy hair usually tied back in a practical ponytail.
physical.description: Lieke is slender and of average height, with a serious demeanor.

quirks: Always has a meticulously organized spreadsheet tracking media mentions.
Insists on using the Oxford comma in all press releases, much to the chagrin of some team members.
Has a habit of pacing when brainstorming ideas.
